name: Yano Midori
source:
A beautiful girl who transfers to the school just as Murakoshi is about to begin his revenge.
A super transfer student with excellent grades and an all-around athlete.
She accidentally becomes close to Murakoshi, which becomes an obstacle to his revenge.
She has medium-long hair that she usually wears in a ponytail.
She is slender with small breasts.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.blackrainbow.jp/br/gakuen/gakuen_chara.html]official site[/url]]
